name: pangram-ai-detector
title: Pangram AI Detector
description: Check selected text for AI-generated content with Pangram, segment by segment.
author: tenequm

commands.name: check-selection
commands.title: Check Selection for AI
commands.description: Runs Pangram AI detection on the text selected in the frontmost app and shows the full report.

commands.name: annotate-selection
commands.title: Annotate Selection
commands.description: Shows the selected text with the AI-generated and AI-assisted passages marked in place.

commands.name: quick-check
commands.title: Quick Check Selection
commands.description: Checks the selected text and shows only the verdict as a HUD, without opening a window.

commands.name: search-history
commands.title: Search Detection History
commands.description: Browses previous detection results, so revisions of the same text can be compared.

tools.name: detect-ai
tools.title: Detect AI Text
tools.description: Scores a piece of text for AI authorship with Pangram and returns the verdict, the AI/AI-assisted/human fractions, and a per-segment breakdown including whether each segment looks humanized.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Pangram API Key
preferences.description: Your Pangram API key. The key needs access to the pangram-4 model.

preferences.name: stripMarkdown
preferences.title: Markdown
preferences.label: Strip Markdown Before Checking
preferences.description: Removes headings, emphasis, link syntax and list markers so Pangram scores your prose rather than the formatting.

preferences.name: dashboardLink
preferences.title: Dashboard
preferences.label: Request a Shareable Pangram Link
preferences.description: Asks Pangram for a public dashboard link to each result. Off by default: turning it on publishes a link to the analyzed text.

evals.input: @pangram-ai-detector Is this paragraph AI written? "In today's rapidly evolving digital landscape, organizations must leverage cutting-edge solutions to remain competitive and drive meaningful outcomes across the value chain."

detect-ai.headline: AI Generated
detect-ai.explanation: We believe that this entire text is AI.

flagged_segments.label: AI-Generated
flagged_segments.text: In today's rapidly evolving digital landscape, organizations must leverage cutting-edge solutions to remain competitive and drive meaningful outcomes across the value chain.
